sai = Sai()

turn = session.send(
    "Open {{newsSite}}, find all {{topic}} news published today, write their headlines into Notepad, one per line, and save the file as {{fileName}}",

snippets.code:
learned = sai.learn.create([turn])
with sai.control.open(machine=pc) as lease:
    r = lease.run(learned, {"newsSite": "TechCrunch", "topic": "Fintech", "fileName": "techcrunch_fintech.txt"})
    if not r.ok:
        learned = sai.learn.create(
            initial_code=learned.code,
            evaluations=[Evaluation(inputs={"newsSite": "TechCrunch", "topic": "Fintech", "fileName": "techcrunch_fintech.txt"}, result=r, passed=False)],
        )

from sai import Check, Evaluation

turn = session.send(
    "Open {{newsSite}}, find all {{topic}} news published today, write their headlines into Notepad, one per line, and save the file as {{fileName}}",
    inputs={"newsSite": "TechCrunch", "topic": "AI", "fileName": "techcrunch_headlines.txt"},
    record_trajectory=True,
)
sai.turns.wait(turn)

learned = sai.learn.create([turn])            # waits for the code; longer for a longer task
with sai.control.open(machine=pc) as lease:
    r = lease.run(learned, {"newsSite": "TechCrunch", "topic": "Fintech", "fileName": "techcrunch_fintech.txt"})   # inputs over the defaults
    print(r.result)

fixed = sai.learn.create(
    initial_code=learned.code,
    evaluations=[Evaluation(inputs={"newsSite": "TechCrunch", "topic": "Fintech", "fileName": "techcrunch_fintech.txt"}, result=r, passed=False)],
)
judgement = sai.judge.create([turn], [Check("file", "The agent saved the headlines to the file")])

snippets.code:
job = sai.learn.create(
    task_template="Open {{newsSite}}, find all {{topic}} news published today, write their headlines into Notepad, one per line, and save the file as {{fileName}}",
    inputs={"newsSite": "TechCrunch", "topic": "AI", "fileName": "techcrunch_headlines.txt"},
    machine=pc,
    criteria="techcrunch_headlines.txt is saved and holds, one per line, the headlines of the AI articles TechCrunch published today",
    max_iterations=3,          # up to 3 code versions; 0 (the default) only writes the code
    rollouts=3,                # each version must pass 3 runs in a row
    reset={"code": """
for (const t of await machine.browser.listTabs()) await machine.browser.closeTab(t.tabId)
for (const w of await machine.getWindow("Notepad")) await w.close()
"""},
    continue_with_agent=True,  # after a failed run, the agent finishes the task and the repair learns from it
)
done = sai.learn.wait(job)     # can take an hour; timeout= to stop waiting
print(done.status, done.stop_reason, done.test_result)
print(done.code)               # the latest version
for it in done.iterations:
    print(it.index, it.changes, [r.verdict for r in it.rollouts])

run = sai.learn.rollout(job, 1, 1)   # what one run returned and logged, and its judgement
sai.learn.cancel(job)                # stops at once and keeps the last complete results

snippets.code:
with sai.control.open(machine=pc) as lease:
    print(lease.shell("hostname")["stdout"])

    lease.write_file(r"C:\data\note.txt", "hello")
    print(lease.read_file(r"C:\data\note.txt"))

    r = lease.exec("""
        var page = await machine.browser.newtab('https://example.com')
        var snap = await page.snapshot()
        snap.title
    """)
    print(r.result)  # Example Domain
    ext = r.screenshot_mime_type.split("/")[1]  # jpeg or png
    open(f"page.{ext}", "wb").write(r.screenshot)
